player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Closet, Sunroom, and Cellar, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep going in the same direction without exploring other options. Next time, I will explore other directions from each room, especially when I'm in a room with multiple available directions. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. For example, when I'm in Cellar, I will try going west first, and then explore other directions if that doesn't lead to a new room.
